title: Counting bird strikes at the east bridge
titleZh: 東側人行橋的鳥撞統計
passage:
Volunteer field card | Riverglass Bird Rescue
At the east pedestrian bridge, count a bird strike only if you see a bird touch the glass railing. A bird flying past the panel is not a strike. Enter groups of birds as separate sightings if you can tell them apart. Do not collect feathers or handle birds; call the rescue desk if a bird remains on the ground.

Email | Rowan to Saturday volunteers
Use the new wall-side entrance this week; work crews have closed the stairs near the river. Our 8:00–9:00 session stays the same. Have one person watch the glass while the other fills in the sheet. If a crew vehicle blocks your view, write down the start and end of the obstruction instead of guessing what happened.

Field log | Saturday | Ivy and Leon
8:13 Two swallows passed in front of panel 4; both continued across the river.
8:26 One sparrow touched panel 2 and flew away.
8:41–8:47 A maintenance van hid panels 1 and 2.
8:52 One pigeon touched panel 4 and stayed on the ground; Ivy phoned the rescue desk.
passageZh:
志工觀察卡｜河玻璃野鳥救援站
在東側人行橋觀察時，只有親眼看見鳥碰到玻璃欄杆，才記為一次撞擊。飛過玻璃板不算撞擊。若能分辨同一群裡的個體，請分開記錄。請勿撿拾羽毛或接觸鳥；如果有鳥一直留在地上，請打電話給救援站。

電子郵件｜Rowan 寄給星期六的志工
本週請走靠牆的新入口，施工人員已封閉河邊的樓梯。觀察時段仍為上午八點到九點。請一人盯著玻璃，另一人填表。若工程車擋住視線，請記下遮擋的起訖時間，不要猜測當時發生了什麼。

觀察紀錄｜星期六｜Ivy 與 Leon
8:13 兩隻燕子飛過 4 號玻璃板前方，接著都飛到河對岸。
8:26 一隻麻雀碰到 2 號玻璃板後飛走。
8:41–8:47 一輛維修貨車遮住 1 號與 2 號玻璃板。
8:52 一隻鴿子碰到 4 號玻璃板後留在地上；Ivy 打給救援站。
